cap: Stimulation releases nitric oxide, which raises cGMP, relaxes cavernosal smooth muscle and lets the sinusoids fill against the tunica albuginea, compressing the veins. PDE5 splits cGMP, so sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil and avanafil prolong the signal but need stimulation. Nitrates add cGMP, so the combination causes severe hypotension. Alprostadil raises cAMP by a parallel route, so it works when PDE5 inhibitors fail. Sildenafil also inhibits phosphodiesterase type 6 in the retina, which causes blue-green vision.
teach: History sorts the cause of erectile dysfunction. Sudden or situational failure with preserved morning erections and normal erections with masturbation is psychogenic, because the nerve and vascular machinery works. Gradual loss with lost nocturnal erections is organic: vascular is most common, then neurogenic, hormonal, drug-induced and anatomic causes such as Peyronie disease and venous leak. Penile arteries are smaller than coronary arteries, so new erectile dysfunction can precede a cardiac event. Nitrates are contraindicated with PDE5 inhibitors: wait 24 hours after sildenafil or vardenafil and 48 hours after tadalafil.
